partial_hits.text:
(1) In this Act, except so far as the contrary intention appears:

165‑CC tagged asset has the meaning given by section 7.

entity has the meaning given by section 4.

small entity: an entity is a small entity for a year if:

small entity cap, for a year, means the amount worked out under section 5.

qualifying receipt means a receipt if:
